#!/bin/bash

# Network Monitoring Script
# Monitors network connectivity by pinging a reliable host every 60 seconds
# Logs the status to /workspace/network_log.txt

LOG_FILE="/workspace/network_log.txt"
TARGET_HOST="8.8.8.8"
INTERVAL=60

# Ensure log file exists
touch "$LOG_FILE"

# Log script start
echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] [INFO] Network monitor started (target: $TARGET_HOST, interval: ${INTERVAL}s)" >> "$LOG_FILE"

# Continuous monitoring loop
while true; do
    TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

    # Ping target host (1 packet, 5-second timeout)
    if ping -c 1 -W 5 "$TARGET_HOST" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        # Capture round-trip time for a more useful message
        RTT=$(ping -c 1 -W 5 "$TARGET_HOST" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'time=[0-9.]+ ?ms' | head -n1)
        if [ -z "$RTT" ]; then
            RTT="reachable"
        fi
        echo "[$TIMESTAMP] [UP] Successfully reached $TARGET_HOST ($RTT)" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "[$TIMESTAMP] [DOWN] Failed to reach $TARGET_HOST - network appears to be down" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    fi

    sleep "$INTERVAL"
done

#!/bin/bash
# CPU Monitoring Script
# Samples CPU usage every 5 seconds for 1 minute (12 samples)

LOG_FILE="/workspace/cpu_monitor.log"
SAMPLES=12
INTERVAL=5

# Write header
echo "===== CPU Monitoring Started at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') =====" > "$LOG_FILE"

# Function to get CPU usage percentage from /proc/stat
get_cpu_usage() {
    read -r _ user1 nice1 sys1 idle1 iowait1 irq1 softirq1 steal1 _ < /proc/stat
    local total_1=$((user1 + nice1 + sys1 + idle1 + iowait1 + irq1 + softirq1 + steal1))
    local idle_a=$((idle1 + iowait1))

    sleep 1

    read -r _ user2 nice2 sys2 idle2 iowait2 irq2 softirq2 steal2 _ < /proc/stat
    local total_2=$((user2 + nice2 + sys2 + idle2 + iowait2 + irq2 + softirq2 + steal2))
    local idle_b=$((idle2 + iowait2))

    local total_diff=$((total_2 - total_1))
    local idle_diff=$((idle_b - idle_a))

    if [ "$total_diff" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "0.0"
    else
        awk -v t="$total_diff" -v i="$idle_diff" 'BEGIN { printf "%.1f", (t - i) * 100 / t }'
    fi
}

# Take samples
for i in $(seq 1 $SAMPLES); do
    TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    CPU_USAGE=$(get_cpu_usage)
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] CPU: ${CPU_USAGE}%" >> "$LOG_FILE"

    # Sleep for the remaining interval (minus the 1s used during measurement)
    if [ "$i" -lt "$SAMPLES" ]; then
        sleep $((INTERVAL - 1))
    fi
done

# Write footer
echo "===== CPU Monitoring Completed at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') =====" >> "$LOG_FILE"
